description: A failed Battle-shock test offers the Command Re-roll ON THE ROLL-CALL CARD, with the failed dice still on screen — it used to pop a second dialog over the top with the dice nowhere in sight. Kommandos' Leadership is set to 13 so 2D6 can never pass, making the failure (and therefore the re-roll offer) deterministic. Drives: Roll → FAILED + re-roll offer → spend 1 CP → the discarded roll is named, the dice tumble again, the second failure applies Battle-shocked → summary lists the unit under Battle-shocked.

steps.script:
# Ld 13 cannot be beaten on 2D6, so the test ALWAYS fails and the Command
# Re-roll is ALWAYS offered — no seed hunting.
GameState.state["units"]["U_KOMMANDOS_H"]["meta"]["stats"]["leadership"] = 13
GameState.state["units"]["U_KOMMANDOS_H"]["flags"].merge({"battle_shocked": false}, true)
GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"] = 3
var ph = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
ph._units_tested.clear()
ph._identify_units_needing_tests()
tree.current_scene.get_node_or_null("CommandController")._refresh_ui()
return ph._units_needing_test

# A real player answers the start-of-phase prompts (secondary-mission review,
# Beacon / Condemn designations, ...) before reaching for the command panel.
# Those are EXCLUSIVE windows, so a real mouse click on the panel underneath
# goes nowhere until they are gone — clear whatever this fixture opened so the
# click under test is the only thing in play.
var closed = []
for c in tree.root.get_children():
	if c is Window and c != tree.root:
		closed.append(String(c.name))
		c.hide()
		c.queue_free()
return true

# 1 CP spent, the discarded roll is named on the card, and the re-rolled
# (still failing) test has applied Battle-shocked.
var d = tree.root.get_node("BattleShockSequenceDialog")
var note = d.get_node("Content/RerollNoteLabel")
var verdict = d.get_node("Content/VerdictLabel").get_parsed_text()
var effects = d.get_node("Content/EffectsLabel").text
var u = GameState.state["units"]["U_KOMMANDOS_H"]
return [
	note.visible,
	note.text.begins_with("Command Re-roll — discarded"),
	int(GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"]) == 2,
	verdict.contains("BATTLE-SHOCKED"),
	effects.contains("OC 0"),
	bool(u.get("flags", {}).get("battle_shocked", false))
]
